key_findings: CCI induces hypersensitivity and spatial/recognition memory deficits in mice.
CCI reduces excitability and spine density of PrL-L5 pyramidal neurons with increased mIPSC frequency, while increasing PrL-L5 GABAergic neuron excitability.
Inhibiting PrL-L5 GABAergic neurons reverses hypersensitivity and memory deficits; activation induces them in naive mice.
ATF4 protein (not mRNA) is upregulated specifically in PrL-L5 GABAergic neurons after CCI; its knockout in these neurons relieves pain and memory deficits.
